items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the great visionary promoter Bill Graham starts The Fillmore West

ctx.x: Farah and Minya... Minya Erica DeJohnette and Farah DeJohnette. We came back to New York with The Charles Lloyd Quartet and we started going to The Fillmore and the great visionary promoter Bill Graham starts The Fillmore West in The Fillmore District of San Francisco.

The venue is still there, it’s in a different building; it’s still there, though. The thing about Bill Graham is he might have Muddy Waters with Jefferson Airplane… he would mix (it) up. He wouldn’t book one particular genre.
